'''Ben Kenobi's hut''' was the residence of Ben Kenobi, alias of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], from [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

It was located at the southwestern edge of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], approximately 136 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]],<ref name="The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi">''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref> at standard coordinates Alpha-1733-Mu-9033 of the first quadrant in the [[Tatooine navigation system]]. Made out of [[synstone]], it comprised a large room that was divided into a living room and a raised kitchen, and a bathroom as a separate room. A cellar contained a power generator and water, and could be entered via a trapdoor. During his nineteen-year stay, Obi-Wan added many of its comforts.

==History==
[[File:Kenobis_hut_layout.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The layout of Kenobi's hut]]
The original dwelling had probably been constructed by a transient who had looked to become a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] or trade with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] but eventually abandoned it. Obi-Wan found it when he began his exile on the desert planet. After riding his [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]] in a widening circle around the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], he found a small hut close enough to the Lars farm so he could watch over [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], but far enough away so he could be considered a hermit and nobody would take much note of him. He kept recordings containing information about the Jedi there, as well as the supplies and equipment needed to create new [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]] recruited a spacer to explore and search the hut. The spacer found a fossilized resonance chamber from a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] that Obi-Wan Kenobi used to terrify [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="SWG:SR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shock Rods|Tatooine}}</ref>

Following his [[Occupation of Bespin|escape]] from [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], Luke Skywalker lived there for several weeks.

Following the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Obi-Wan's hut was made into an attraction of the [[Skywalker Tour]], having been rediscovered and restored by [[Myhr Rho]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], after [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] allowed [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to draw her to the hut, she found it ransacked, void of everything save for Kenobi's workbench and a mysterious [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] in the cellar. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Luke Skywalker returned to the hut in an unsuccessful attempt to reestablish a connection with his long-dead mentor. When he arrived, the hut was in nearly the same state as his sister had found it, save for the fact that the roof had caved in.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BensHut_interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The interior of Kenobi's hut]]

In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''A New Hope'' novelization]], Ben Kenobi's home was located in a cave rather than the hut seen in the movie. This depiction of Kenobi's home being a cave rather than a hut is seen in [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|JVC's 1991 ''Star Wars'' video game]].

The original movie was filmed in an old harbor in south [[Tunisia]]. Long ago the harbor moved 3 kilometers south, forming the town [[Ajim]]. The house is still used as a meeting place, and therefore is regularly renovated. For the 1997 [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of the film, the shot has been replaced with a combination model/digital matte painting of a larger hut.

===Non-canon material===
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[File:Obi_Wans_Cave_entrance.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The entrance to Obi-Wan's Cave]]
Luke Skywalker's new droid, R2-D2, brought him into pursuit of a General Kenobi. Luke located Kenobi's residence in a cave colloquially known as '''Obi-Wan's Cave''' for the desert hermit living within. Luke evaded the dangerous pitfalls and rampant [[Sandfly/Legends|sand flies]] to speak with Obi-Wan Kenobi. Kenobi subsequently gifted Luke his father's lightsaber and became his spiritual guide during the Rebellion's assault on the Death Star.<ref name="JVC">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
